evidence.notes: A public Salesforce cursor delete-filter enum exercised against Glade's deterministic local SOQL rows.

name: current-base-local-runtime-required-Database.Cursor-001
notes: Hosted API 67 witness for Database.Cursor.DeleteFilter with a filename-matching test class.

source.content: @isTest private class CurrentBaseDeterministicMockRequiredDatabaseCursor001Test { @isTest static void cursorDeleteFilterUsesDeterministicLocalRows() { insert new Account(Name = 'Cursor'); Database.Cursor cursor = Database.getCursor('SELECT Id FROM Account'); Database.Cursor.DeleteFilter filter = Database.Cursor.DeleteFilter.NO_FILTER; System.assertEquals(1, cursor.getNumRecords()); System.assertEquals(Database.Cursor.DeleteFilter.NO_FILTER, filter); } }
